forecasts.target_frontier_problem: Prediction of cognitive trajectory in preclinical AD patients with elevated plasma pTau217 but normal baseline MoCA (>26)
forecasts.abduced_hypothesis: Cortical FDG-PET metabolic reserve in the temporoparietal network acts as a threshold gate delaying cognitive decline by at least 3.5 years regardless of pTau217 phosphorylation levels.
forecasts.formal_mechanism: forall patient, (Plasma_pTau217 >= 0.60 pg/mL and FDG_PET_Temporoparietal_Z >= -1.0) => Annual_MoCA_Decline <= 0.35 points/year
forecasts.decisive_falsification_protocol: 5-year longitudinal follow-up cohort of N=150 preclinical subjects (A+/T+/N- vs A+/T+/N+) with bi-annual digital cognitive assessments and PET imaging.

forecasts.target_frontier_problem: Overcoming secondary resistance mutations (Y96D, H95Q) in KRAS G12C allosteric Switch-II inhibitor regimens.
forecasts.abduced_hypothesis: Bivalent covalent engagement bridging Cys12 and the dynamic α3-helix allosteric pocket induces irreversible switch-II stabilization even in the presence of Y96D steric clash mutations.
forecasts.formal_mechanism: forall mutant_KRAS(Y96D), (Bivalent_Covalent_Occupancy >= 0.85) => (GTP_Exchange_Rate <= 0.05 min^-1 and IC50 <= 15.0 nM)

quantitative_prediction.target_metric: In vitro IC50 against KRAS G12C/Y96D Ba/F3 cell line (nM)

forecasts.decisive_falsification_protocol: Synthetic crystallization and mass spectrometry kinetic binding assay of bis-electrophilic switch-II inhibitors against purified recombinant KRAS G12C/Y96D protein.

forecasts.target_frontier_problem: Mechanism of non-coding STMN2 cryptic exon suppression rescue in human motor neurons lacking nuclear TDP-43.
forecasts.abduced_hypothesis: Steric blocking antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) targeting the cryptic splice donor site in STMN2 intron 1 fully restore full-length STMN2 mRNA expression and axonal outgrowth in TDP-43 depleted iPSC neurons.
forecasts.formal_mechanism: forall neuron(TDP43_depleted), (ASO_STMN2_Dose >= 50 nM) => (STMN2_FL_mRNA >= 0.80 WT_level and Axon_Regeneration >= 0.75 WT_rate)

quantitative_prediction.target_metric: STMN2 Full-length mRNA Recovery (% of Wild-Type)

forecasts.decisive_falsification_protocol: TDP-43 siRNA knockdown in human iPSC-derived cortical and motor neurons followed by Nanopore long-read direct RNA sequencing and microfluidic axonal outgrowth tracking.

forecasts.target_frontier_problem: Atmospheric mass loss boundary distinguishing Rocky Super-Earths from Sub-Neptunes orbiting M-dwarf host stars.
forecasts.abduced_hypothesis: Planets with core mass M_core < 3.2 M_earth within the habitable zone of active M-dwarfs experience 100% loss of primordial H/He envelopes within 500 Myr due to high-energy stellar wind erosion.
forecasts.formal_mechanism: forall planet(M_core < 3.2 M_earth, Stellar_Type == M_dwarf, Age >= 0.5 Gyr) => Atmospheric_Envelope_H2_Fraction <= 0.001
forecasts.decisive_falsification_protocol: JWST NIRSpec / MIRI transmission spectroscopy of 20 newly discovered transiting M-dwarf exoplanets from PLATO and TESS extended missions.
